title: Your bathroom break just became your gym
excerpt: 90 seconds. No equipment. No one watching you struggle. Just you, a bathroom stall, and the easiest workout you'll do all week.
source: PLOS ONE research on micro-breaks, U.S. sedentary behavior statistics

title: Evening Workouts Don't Ruin Your Sleep
excerpt: For decades, we've been told to avoid exercise before bed. Turns out, science says that's mostly wrong.

title: Your elevator commute just became your gym
excerpt: That awkward 30 seconds staring at the floor numbers? Yeah, we're turning that into your secret fitness hack. No gym clothes required.

title: Short daily stair climbing improved heart fitness by 17%
excerpt: A British Journal of Sports Medicine study found that short, repeated stair climbs — each about 2 minutes — increased VO₂ max by 17.1% in 8 weeks. No gym, no equipment required.

title: 4.5 minutes a day cuts cancer risk by 32%
excerpt: New research shows non-exercisers who do brief bursts of vigorous activity throughout the day dramatically reduce their cancer risk. No gym required.
